draft.subject: Re: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Glad to hear things are going well and that the layout is starting to click -- that's a good sign this early.

Since your first project is up, the natural next step is getting real work into it: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. And whenever you're ready to bring the rest of Maple Media in, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through whatever's still feeling unfamiliar and answer anything on setup.

Best,
Nadia
